title: Department of Commerce Announces Finalization of CHIPS Incentives with Powerex to Enhance Domestic Production Capacity of Key Components for U.S. Semiconductor Manufacturing
summary: The U.S. Department of Commerce announced today the signing of a Direct Funding Agreement with Powerex to invest $30 million in manufacturing and R&D to dramatically expand domestic power module production.
author: Andrew Kim
title_norm: department of commerce announces finalization of chips incentives with powerex to enhance domestic production capacity of key components for u s semiconductor manufacturing
